sections.section: ORDER - President's Order 9, Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) (Sixth Amendment) Order 1985
sections.description:
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 9 OF 1985
PRESIDENT'S ORDER
9 OF 1985
HOUSES OF
PARLIAMENT AND PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLIES (ELECTIONS) (SIXTH AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1985
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 20th January, 1985]
No. F. 17 (3)/85-Pub.--The
following Order made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
In pursuance of the Proclamation
of the fifth day of July, 1977, and in exercise of all powers enabling him in
that behalf, the President is pleased to make the following Order:-
1. Short title and
commencement.-(1) This Order may be called the Houses of Parliament and
Provincial Assemblies (Elections) (Sixth Amend ment) Order, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of Article 4, P.
(P. P.) O. No. 5 of 1977.--In the Houses of Parliament and Provincial
Assemblies (Elections) Order, 1977 [P. (P. P.) O. No. 5 of 1977], hereinafter
referred to as the said Order, in Article 4, in clause (1), in paragraph (b),-
(a) after the
word "Hindus", the words "and persons belonging to the scheduled
castes" shall be inserted ; and
(b) the words
"and persons belonging to the scheduled castes" shall be omitted.
3. Amendment of Article 6, P.
(P. P.) O. No. 5 of 1977.-In the said Order, in Article 6, in clause (1),
in paragraph (b),-
(a) after the
word "Hindus" the words "and persons belonging to the scheduled
castes" shall be added ; and
(b) the words "and persons
belonging to the scheduled castes" shall be omitted.
